hotels.title: Award-Winning English Countryside Luxury near London with Daily Breakfast, Outdoor Pool & Golf Course
hotels.description: Less than an hour from London lies an 18th-century mansion and one of England’s most celebrated countryside retreats, voted the 6th Best Resort in Europe in Condé Nast Traveller's 2025 Readers' Choice Awards. The Grove sits within 300 acres of rolling parkland with a championship golf course, award-winning spa and an activity centre. When the sun is out, a heated outdoor pool and landscaped beach area offer a unique seaside feel. Come mealtimes, The Glasshouse serves modern international cuisine overlooking the gardens while The Stables handles all-day dining in a characterful converted setting. Madhu's brings acclaimed Indian cuisine to the table, and Skewd's offers Turkish-inspired sharing plates. Sequoia spa features a 22-metre mosaic-tiled pool, jacuzzi, Bamford treatments and a dedicated dining space. Anouska's Kids Club keeps younger guests entertained, while an open-air cinema (seasonal), archery, axe throwing and Jemima's Kitchen Garden bring together a stay that goes far beyond the usual countryside hotel experience.
